verdict.rationale: Snowflake hosts customer data and offers AI features such as Cortex AI Functions with third-party LLMs, so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, contractual no-training commitment, or AI data-usage policy. RBAC, compliance certifications, and Data Clean Rooms are related privacy controls but do not address model training.
